headline: Last session: Sensex jumped 800 points, snapping an eight-week losing streak as Nifty closed above 22,500.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 12 October.

why: Sensex jumped over 800 points and Nifty closed above the 22,500 level in the last session
Indian shares ended their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years
The market successfully snapped an eight-week losing streak with a 'Good Friday' rally
Positive momentum was driven by five major contributors and recovery from a 32-month low
whatHappening: FM Sitharaman met global investment fund executives to discuss opportunities in India

summary: Indian markets ended their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years during the last session, with the Sensex gaining over 800 points. The Nifty 50 closed above the 22,500 mark as investors reacted to global cues and investment discussions led by the Finance Minister. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 12 October 2026.
